name: Home
description: Home word search puzzles use room and household English for adults and seniors — porch, pantry, hearth, attic, curtain and quiet living words — without furniture or appliance brands. Play free online with easy, medium, hard and large print. No account and no timer: just familiar nouns from kitchens, landings and soft evenings indoors. Short words such as door, key and rug keep easy grids friendly; longer anchors like fireplace, bookcase and dwelling steady harder boards. Pair with Kitchen and Garden when you want a wider domestic hour. Large print helps on phones propped by the sofa. Written for grown-up living spaces, not for shopping catalogs.
